_comment: The printable files copied into stl/lego/ and what each is for. Quantities are per robot.

ev3-pixy2.what: Crank walker for the EV3 brick, two EV3 large motors and a Pixy2

chassis.stl.purpose: deck with strap slots for the brick, two side panels with the axle row, forward shelf for the head

camera_head.stl.purpose: head with a perforated face for the Pixy2 LEGO edition brackets; print this or camera_head_pantilt, not both

camera_head_pantilt.stl.purpose: head with a slotted top platform for the base plate of the Pixy2 pan-tilt kit; alternative to camera_head
camera_head_pantilt.stl.note: platform size is assumed: measure the kit's base plate first

left_leg.stl.purpose: left leg and foot, fingers at +/-70 mm

right_leg.stl.purpose: right leg and foot, fingers at +/-27 mm

crank_print_4.stl.purpose: crank, 12 mm radius, cross-axle bore and pin bore

gear_16t_print_6.stl.purpose: 16-tooth module 1 spur gear, 5 mm thick, cross-axle bore

fit_coupon.stl.purpose: fit test: cross-axle hole, 4.95 mm pin hole, 5.35 mm bearing hole; print first

pi-zero-2w-51515.what: Crank walker for a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with the Build HAT, two 51515 medium angular motors and a Camera Module 2

chassis.stl.purpose: deck with four M2.5 bosses on 58 x 23 mm centres, two side panels with the axle row, forward shelf for the head

camera_head.stl.purpose: head with a 21 x 12.5 mm M2 pattern for the Camera Module 2

left_leg.stl.purpose: left leg and foot, fingers at +/-70 mm

right_leg.stl.purpose: right leg and foot, fingers at +/-27 mm

crank_print_4.stl.purpose: crank, 12 mm radius, cross-axle bore and pin bore

gear_16t_print_6.stl.purpose: 16-tooth module 1 spur gear, 5 mm thick, cross-axle bore

fit_coupon.stl.purpose: fit test: cross-axle hole, 4.95 mm pin hole, 5.35 mm bearing hole; print first
